metadata.label: Wandering Tracer Renderer
metadata.description: Paints shared tracer paths with the saved watercolor, hatch, rim, and rounded-tip treatment.

image.label: Image
image.description: Background image under the tracer pigment.

image.label: Image
image.description: Background with tracer pigment composited over it.

controlDescriptions.bleed: Scales the original textured watercolor diffusion and edge deposit.
controlDescriptions.contrast: Matches the saved painting at one and softens pigment and rim contrast toward zero.
controlDescriptions.hatch: Scales the dense lifetime-seeded hatch ink without changing its spacing family.

metadata.label: Living Painting
metadata.description: Organic watercolor regions that adopt new colors and hatch styles when shared tracer paths cross them.

paths.label: Paths
paths.description: Shared tracer geometry used to carve the regions.

image.label: Image
image.description: The painting before tracer ink is composited.

controls.label: Tension and release
controls.description: Slow build, crest, release, and rest. Shapes lead; linework and color follow.

controls.label: Tension
controls.description: Strength of local pressure, contrasting line directions, and rhythmic compression.

controls.label: Large and small rhythm
controls.description: Large anchor regions alternate with smaller supporting regions.

controls.label: Average spacing
controls.description: Overall spacing scale. Each region keeps its own spacing ratio.

controls.label: Overall bend
controls.description: Strength of distinct regional styles: restrained lines, sweeping curves, fans, and contours.

controls.label: Direction bias
controls.description: Shifts the overall direction while preserving regional relationships.

controls.label: Average ink weight
controls.description: Overall stroke weight. Dense patterns tend toward finer strokes; open patterns can carry heavier marks.

controls.label: Neighboring harmony
controls.description: Neighboring patterns share direction, with occasional opposing accents.

metadata.label: Wandering Tracer Paths
metadata.description: Generates reusable paths that enter from the canvas perimeter and grow across the frame.

paths.label: Paths
paths.description: Grown tracer paths in centered canvas-height coordinates.

controlDescriptions.count: Sets the number of independent tracer lifetimes, up to four.
controlDescriptions.curl: Sets the stable curvature chosen for each lifetime.
controlDescriptions.pace: Scales artistic time while deposition timestamps remain scene seconds.
controlDescriptions.seed: Chooses perimeter entries, headings, pigments, and hatch families.
controlDescriptions.speed: Sets how quickly each tracer head advances through canvas-height space.
controlDescriptions.sway: Sets a subtle shared-body movement without changing the deposited route.
controlDescriptions.width: Sets the full ribbon width in canvas-height units.
